admitted_r1c_fact: Transparent content inherits the containing part of the parent content model iteratively.
With scripting disabled and outside head, noscript is transparent; in head it has the separate link/style/meta content model.
Autonomous custom elements are transparent, but autonomous identity depends on a custom element definition and is not established by source hyphen syntax alone.
Pinned Lexbor exposes an explicit parser scripting-mode setter/readback; V1N1 R1C freezes the current checker path to disabled.
